answer: A sybil farm grades its own answers a perfect 3, inflating rewards for every fake. Honeypot answers: each epoch the protocol slips secret plants of known quality into grading panels, like a thread of saffron hidden in rice. A grader who scores a junk plant 3 loses its seat and 10% of its bond; with 4 plants per panel, half of them junk, a rubber-stamping fake survives an epoch with odds of 1 in 16. Honest graders build a mesa of clean records. Limit: a leak of the plants would rust the test like ferrous metal in rain.
